customer: Hi, I recently moved to Dunmore and want to sell my minivan. It has a rebuilt title — will Northwind Auto still buy it?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and welcome to Dunmore! As explained in our article "Salvage and rebuilt titles," we now buy cars with rebuilt titles, at a reduced offer that reflects the brand, and the specialist confirms the amount at the appraisal. When you request your offer, please select the rebuilt title brand, because an offer made for a clean title will change at the appraisal if the title turns out to be branded. Please note that we still don't buy cars with salvage or flood titles.
